name: Can crawl space mold return after professional remediation?

mainEntity.name: Can crawl space mold return after professional remediation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional mold remediation focuses not only on removing existing mold but also on identifying and addressing the underlying moisture issues that caused it. When the moisture source, such as leaks or high humidity, is effectively controlled or eliminated after the remediation, the chances of mold returning are significantly reduced. However, if new water intrusions or persistent moisture problems are not managed, mold can potentially recur.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold is unlikely to return after professional remediation if the underlying moisture issues are fully resolved. Ongoing moisture control is key.
